notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/magistral-medium-1-1-25-07, redirects to /models/magistral-medium-1-1-25-07). It is a product/lifecycle page (date, context 40k, features, retirement), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Modalities appear only as icons with the label Modalities and no plain-text modality names, so modalities is not_stated. Header date July 24, 2025 is treated as releaseDate (description also says released July 2025). Legal Center link (https://legal.mistral.ai/ai-governance/models/magistral-medium-1) has lifecycle table only; not a seed alsoDocument. alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup. No pageCount (web page).
